title: Care Desk Guidance: Tailwise Training Class Transfers
content:
## Class transfers on Tailwise Training enrollments

**Rule.** Where class transfer is allowed, an enrollment may move to another start date or store of the same course up to the course's transfer allowance, for the course's transfer fee. A transfer is allowed only before the second session of the course. Sessions already used stay used.

| Course or pack | Class transfer allowed | Transfers allowed per enrollment | Fee per transfer (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Puppy Training 6-Week Group | Yes | 1 | 0.00 |
| Adult Basic Training 6-Week Group | Yes | 1 | 0.00 |
| Intermediate Training 6-Week Group | Yes | 1 | 0.00 |
| Advanced Training & CGC Prep 6-Week Group | Yes | 1 | 0.00 |
| Private Training 4-Session Pack | No | 0 | 0.00 |
| Private Training 8-Session Pack | No | 0 | 0.00 |

**Reading the rule.**

- What moves is the enrollment, to another class start date or another store, and always within the same course.
- Each group course allows 1 transfer per enrollment, free of charge. The private packs do not allow class transfers.
- The timing limit is the second session: once the course's second session has taken place, a transfer is no longer allowed.
- A session already used before the transfer stays used; it is not restored by moving the enrollment.

**Judgement table (hypothetical group enrollment, allowance 1)**

| Sessions of the course held so far | Transfers already used | Transfer allowed? |
|---|---|---|
| None | 0 | Yes |
| Session 1 only | 0 | Yes; session 1 stays used |
| Session 1 only | 1 | No; the allowance of 1 is used |
| Sessions 1 and 2 | 0 | No; the second session has passed |

**Illustration (hypothetical).** A customer whose dog attended the first session of an Intermediate Training 6-Week Group class wants to join a class at another store. The second session has not yet taken place and no transfer has been used, so the enrollment may move to the other store's class of the Intermediate Training 6-Week Group at no fee; session 1 stays used.
